verdict.rationale: GitLab publishes a technology-partner directory listing many third-party integrations (Cursor, Greptile, Make, monday.com, Notion, Semgrep, PagerDuty, and others). Its AI Catalog also lets users discover and share agents and flows created by the GitLab team and community. However, the evidence shows the partner directory is a listing page, not an in-product install flow; setup appears to happen through each partner. The one-click install mention covers cluster applications, which is adjacent rather than a third-party marketplace. Missing for 10: documented in-product install/enable flow from the directory, app permission/consent model, independent hands-on corroboration of installing integrations from the directory.
